book.Title: &WThe Owls Are Not What They Seem
book.page: The owls are not what they seem. The spectral gleam! There! Across the psychic sea! To say I 'see' is not quite right. It's not quite sight. It is older. From the time before heat burst from a point, and showered the cosmos in light. It was colder. Oblivion stretched across and through the borders of unending night, As if in a dream. They're not what they seem.
